facts.fact: Guineematin reports that the ministry held a round table on 4-5 December 2024 on the national state-digitalisation strategy, calls its "élaboration" proof of the government's will, and quotes the minister saying the strategy has been in "mise en œuvre" since 2022; no adoption is stated.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de digitalisation de l'État et de développement de l'économie numérique 2023-2027

facts.fact: The article gives the strategy as "2023-2026", with a vision of a highly digitalised administration by 2026 (the instrument is listed elsewhere as 2023-2027).
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de digitalisation de l'État et de développement de l'économie numérique 2023-2027

note: Class is empty: the article names the strategy as one for digitalising the state but does not describe its full scope; the stated vision concerns the administration.
